recap.text: Firas stays close to Louis and a party of car salesmen with bows in the desert quadrant. He marches on a Bactrian town and runs back to Hump Town. Firas cuts a camel's neck with a long knife and stomps an empty robe. An ambassador runs a changeling check on him.

Firas tells Samantha how to reach the security room by climbing from the first floor to the fifth, crossing to the main thoroughfare, and descending to the third. He pats Louis on the back while Louis cries over the Twister. Firas is eliminated on the sixth floor in a desert. A manager sobered him up before he lasted one more floor.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Crawler Firas. Fifth floor, desert quadrant. Located in the company of Crawler Louis and Langley's team, a party of car salesmen who have taken up the bow, at the moment Crawler Carl's group came looking for other crawlers. Keeps close to Louis. Present for the march on the Bactrian town and for the run back to Hump Town that followed it. The file on this one is thin. So is the file on most of you.
beats.gist: Crawler Firas stays close to Crawler Louis and a team of bow-wielding car salesmen.

beats.headline: A throat with nobody behind it
beats.text: Subject Firas is seated in the back cart behind a Henrik who is not Henrik. On cue he stands, draws a long knife and runs it across the camel's neck. The blood sprays convincingly. Then he stands staring at the knife, stupidly, until Crawler Carl tells him by chat to stomp the head, fast. He stomps an empty robe several times. Told to sit and be inconspicuous, he sits. When the ambassador heads for the cart, subject asks the chat what he is doing, twice. The ambassador runs his changeling check on him and moves on to the body.
beats.gist: Firas runs a long knife across a camel's neck and stomps an empty robe.

beats.headline: He talks Samantha through the map
beats.text: Samantha is in the cat's tunnels and has forgotten the way to the security room. Louis is busy with the airship, so the job falls to Firas: from the first floor she has to climb to the fifth, cross to the main thoroughfare and come down again to the third. On it, he says. Afterwards he stands with Carl and Louis, patting his friend on the back while Louis holds back tears over the Twister, and points out how calm the guards are.
beats.gist: Firas tells Samantha how to reach the security room from the cat's tunnels.

beats.headline: Dead, with the Popovs
beats.text: Crawler Firas has been eliminated on the sixth floor. Crawler Princess Donut is bringing the night's count to Crawler Carl as I speak, and his name is on it, next to the Popovs. Found in a desert. Sobered up by a manager. Lasted one floor past that. The file is closed. It was never a thick one.
beats.gist: Firas is eliminated on the sixth floor and found in a desert.
